name: Docker
description: Grants agents docker and docker-compose CLI capability through an allowlist, plus protections for Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml.

allowedCommands.label: Allowed Docker Subcommands
allowedCommands.description: Comma-separated docker subcommands agents may run (e.g. ps, logs, compose up). Empty (default) means no docker commands allowed.

wslEngineGuide.label: WSL Engine Guide
wslEngineGuide.description: When on (default), TPM surfaces Docker Engine install steps for WSL2 Ubuntu if no docker binary is reachable. When off, TPM assumes docker is already configured.

engineSocketCheck.label: Engine Socket Check
engineSocketCheck.description: When on (default), TPM checks the Docker daemon socket is reachable before running a docker command. When off, TPM just tries the command and lets it fail.
